observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Outdoor festival or campground on a raised wooden platform with vehicles, tents, and other attendees in the background
observation.dancers: Multiple mixed couples dancing in a group
observation.formation_and_space: Couples dancing in close proximity on a shared platform
observation.posture: Upright torsos with soft knees and frequent deep dips and lunges
observation.footwork: Stepping on the beat with side-to-side weight shifts, spins, and turns in cowboy boots; exact rapid heel-toe placement is obscured by low camera resolution and footwear
observation.arms_and_hands: Partner hand holds, overhead turns, leading and spinning the partner, and wrapping arms around each other's waists
observation.hips_and_torso: Natural movement with expressive dips, leans, and bends
observation.partnering: Close-contact partner dancing with active leading and following, frequent spins, dips, and lifts
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent deep knee bends, dips, backbends, and partner lifts/carries, with continuous spinning turns
observation.costume_and_props: Casual outdoor attire: t-shirts, jeans, and cowboy boots; one dancer wearing a black beanie and cap
observation.cannot_infer: Precise footwork details like toe-heel transitions are occluded by boots and low video resolution.

signature_moments.what: The leader dips the follower backward into a low backbend while supporting her weight
The leader lifts the follower horizontally across his body and carries her in a circle
The leader dips the follower backward to the floor while dropping to one knee
The leader drops to one knee while the follower spins and leans over him
